failure_diagnosis.mechanism: Frozen candidate is a platform package containing package/bin/zg but no package.json bin/directories.bin/install script. Native harness npm install -g plus command -v zg requires a global CLI entry. This is a structural package/installer contract mismatch.
failure_diagnosis.not_model_provider_failure: No QA agent_execution or provider-error response is retained. Source order places this exception before embedding configuration, grant, index and MCP initialization.
failure_diagnosis.smoke_gap: The successful source-image smoke directly untarred and executed package/bin/zg --version; it did not exercise npm global CLI linking or the native installer.
failure_diagnosis.limitation: Actual install stdout/stderr and ZG_BIN_PATH were not retained. Do not claim npm itself succeeded or that absent QA means total network/cost zero.
